column5: ★ NEW ROW - THERE WAS NO status.price-grid.tsv AT ALL, which is the most invisible failure mode in this catalog: a section with no file cannot be stale, cannot be wrong, and cannot be found. price-grid IS a registered section (build-registry.mjs:85 + :194 + :253 + :288, sectionFile key `price-grid`) with 20 harvested frames, all sitting at status `unknown` with cited=0 - and cited=0 here means the citation scan never ran, not that nothing exists. WHAT IS TRUE: the game ships with an 8-file component directory, a route, a page shell, a tile (Play.tsx flag map + FEATURED_GAMES + nav + switch), art in playGameArt.ts and an entry in GameDetailPage.tsx; DEFAULT_CONFIG price_grid_enabled=true. IT IS THE ONLY GAME OF THE 21 WITH NO POINTS RAIL - `price_grid` appears 0 times in supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts and 11 times in game-settlement/index.ts, so it settles on the sUSD/edge-function path only. `partial` because PlayPriceGrid.tsx has no *PageSections companion, so the two 1440 page frames (10030:30838 at 1440x3294 and 10030:39086 at 1440x3567, both filed "Blackjack") and the 375 page 9907:8770 are unbuilt. FIGMA DRIFT: ZERO both directions (20 live on 9660:2, 20 harvested). ★ CORRECTED 2026-08-26 (report 0c7e5de8): the phrase "art in playGameArt.ts" above described the PLACEHOLDER entry (accent wash + Target glyph), not a cover - the tile shipped with no illustration. It has one now. The cover is 10030:39274, nested inside the page frame 10030:39086, at 195x277 (the Desktop cover geometry) with a title-free fill and a declared gradient stop #118461; wired in skai-gaming 69fa305 as figma/price-grid.webp. ⚠️ DO NOT confuse it with 10030:31138, the "Game details" hero on the same page, which is a BACCARAT card under a "Blackjack" heading and whose raster is the file the repo ships as figma/baccarat.webp - lifting that one puts baccarat art on a price game. Two sweeps opened 31138, concluded "price-grid has no cover anywhere in Figma", and pinned it in a passing test. ⚠️ AND NOTE WHAT "FIGMA DRIFT: ZERO" DOES NOT MEAN: the 20 harvested nodes are the page's TOP-LEVEL children (a Directory, 3 Breakpoints, 3 page frames, 8 Ellipses, 2 Groups); 10030:39274 is not among them and never could have been. A drift count says the harvest is current, not that the section is enumerated. See TRAPS.md section 15.
